run_label_interaction_points_read: run the label interaction points script in read mode to show labeled points from H5 dataset files
run_label_interaction_points_write: run the label interaction points script in write mode to label interaction points on point clouds
run_pick_points: run the pick points function to interactively select points from an Open3D point cloud visualization
review_pick_points: review the pick points function that uses Open3D VisualizerWithEditing for interactive point selection
summarize_main: summarize the main CLI entry point that iterates H5 files and labels interaction points in read or write mode
